{07 04 00}Hey?!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 16 00}Where do you think
you're going? I'm STILL HERE!

{07 00 00}OK, fine.{01 00 00 05 00} If you need to go
somewhere, I'll just leave,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Kuule?!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 16 00}Kuhu sa arvad, et
sa lähed? Ma olen ju SIIN!

{07 00 00}Olgu, hästi.{01 00 00 05 00} Kui sul on vaja
kuhugi minna, ma lahkun,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 06 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} What's wrong?
Do you have some secret
business to take care of?!
{07 00 00}Well, if you're leaving...{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 0b 00}I guess I gotta go too,
huh?
messages.et:
{07 06 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Mis lahti?
Kas sul on mingi salajane
asi ajada?!
{07 00 00}Noh, kui sa lahkud...{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 0b 00}Vist pean mina ka minema,
mis?
